pages.text: $(bold)Chicken Coop$()$(br)Poultry lay their eggs inside; collected eggs gather in their own slot, and moving them into the incubating slot gets them hatching.

$(bold)Ranch Trough$()$(br)A one-slot feeder for feed (wheat, carrots, or this mods feeds) or pure water; hungry or thirsty animals nearby wander over to eat.$(br2)House them well, and remember to keep the food and water topped up.
